name: Firewall Dashboard v4
description: Edge firewall — DNAT verified, content filter / WAN failover event-driven, BGW WAN blocks, syslog ingest health.

0.content:
## Firewall Dashboard v4
[v3 dashboard](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.dashboards/dashboard/69f08256-8454-4551-89f4-e844cc585e7e) · Syslog `syslog-172.16.1.1.log` · DNAT metric `log.firewall_portforward_hits`
**DNAT ingest restored (2026-09-09):** UDM `rsyslogd` includes `firewall_default_policy` (+ `log_all_contents`). External port-forward hits emit `PortForward DNAT` to dt02 and Dynatrace. Content-filter and wan-failover/ubios remain event-driven. BGW WAN blocks use the dt02 poller.

1.query:
fetch logs, from: now()-24h
| filter matchesValue(log.file.name, "syslog-172.16.1.1.log")
| summarize total = count(),
    cef = countIf(matchesPhrase(content, "CEF: 0|Ubiquiti")),
    dnat = countIf(matchesPhrase(content, "PortForward DNAT")),
    content_filter = countIf(matchesPhrase(content, "contentFilteringBlock")),
    wan_failover = countIf(contains(content, "wan-failover") or contains(content, "ubios"))
| fields total, cef, dnat, content_filter, wan_failover
1.title: UDM Syslog Ingest Health (24h)

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter matchesValue(log.file.name, "syslog-172.16.1.1.log")
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "PortForward DNAT")
| filter isNotNull(fw.dnat.src) or isNotNull(SRC)
| fieldsAdd src = coalesce(fw.dnat.src, SRC)
| summarize hits = count(), by:{src}
| sort hits desc
| limit 15
3.title: Top External Sources (DNAT)

4.query:
fetch logs
| filter matchesValue(log.file.name, "syslog-172.16.1.1.log")
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "PortForward DNAT")
| filter isNotNull(fw.dnat.service) or isNotNull(service)
| fieldsAdd svc = coalesce(fw.dnat.service, service)
| summarize hits = count(), by:{svc}
| sort hits desc
4.title: Hits by Service

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter matchesValue(log.file.name, "syslog-172.16.1.1.log")
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "contentFilteringBlock")
| filter NOT matchesPhrase(content, "NEWLY_DISCOVERED_DOMAINS")
| filter isNotNull(fw.filter.category) or matchesPhrase(content, "contentFilteringBlock")
| fieldsAdd category = coalesce(fw.filter.category, "unknown")
| summarize blocks = count(), by:{category}
| sort blocks desc
| limit 10
5.title: Content Filter Blocks

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "att-bgw320" and isNotNull(bgw.fw.reason)
| summarize blocks = count(), by:{bgw.fw.reason}
| sort blocks desc
| limit 10
6.title: BGW WAN Blocks by Reason
